== DecipherCon 1999 identification (26 October 2026) ==
The player listed as the Young Jedi Qualifier #4 (sealed) winner at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Decipher score sheet YJ.04) is the same person as [[Rob Jones]]. Bill confirmed this identification on 26 October 2026. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 17:42, 26 October 2026 (UTC)
